chunks: And from his words (peace be upon him): He addressed the Kharijites when they separated from the government and called out, 'No judgment except for Allah.'

key_terms.الْخَوَارِجَ: The Kharijites, a early Islamic sect known for their rebellion
key_terms.لَا حُكْمَ إِلَّا لِلَّهِ: No judgment except for Allah, the slogan of the Kharijites

ai.seo_question: What was the slogan of the Kharijites when they separated from Imam Ali's government?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) confronted the Kharijites, who had seceded from his caliphate under the slogan 'La hukma illa lillah' (No judgment except God), arguing that their interpretation was a literalist distortion ignoring the necessity of human juristic reasoning (ijtihad) alongside divine law. This address, recorded in Nahj al-Balagha, establishes a foundational Shia political principle that governance requires qualified leadership to implement Sharia, countering the Kharijite claim that any just ruler or even the masses could directly apply God's law without mediation.
